name: Christian Galvez Organ Trio
description: Kick off the weekend with a free evening of jazz on the iconic terrace of Casa da Música.
longDescription:
The Christian Galvez Organ Trio performs a free jazz concert on the Casa da Música Terrace on July 23, 2026. Christian Galvez, a Chilean bassist and composer, leads the trio, known for its contemporary approach to jazz, blending traditional organ trio sounds with modern influences. This performance offers an opportunity to hear their distinctive sound in an outdoor setting.

Attendees can expect an evening of instrumental music in a relaxed atmosphere. The concert takes place on the terrace of Casa da Música, a prominent architectural landmark in Porto, providing an open-air environment for the performance. The event is suitable for a general audience interested in jazz music.

This is a free event, with no tickets required for entry. The Casa da Música is accessible via public transport, with the Casa da Música metro station (lines A, B, C, E, F) located directly opposite the venue. Several bus lines also serve the area. The venue is generally accessible.
